response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, mobile and embedded work, strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, real AWS (CDK) delivery, and a demonstrated culture of mentoring, TDD and engineering excellence — all of which map well to the staff-level and customer-facing craft expectations. However, the role's core bar is 8+ years building production GenAI systems, and the resume shows only about one year of adjacent AI work (MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq). There is no evidence of Python, vector databases, RAG architectures, multi-agent frameworks, LLM evaluation/observability pipelines, or data pipelines for unstructured data. Worth a conversation as a strong platform/agent-infrastructure engineer who could grow into the role, but he is not a match for the stated GenAI experience requirement.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems; genuine staff-level breadth and mentoring/teaching track record
Strong TypeScript/Node.js plus AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes and high-throughput microservice experience
Recent hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic-workflow tooling work — directly relevant emerging skill
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-related work versus the required 8+ years of production AI solutions
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/observability or multi-agent framework experience
Python absent from the skills list; no evidence of ML/data-pipeline work on structured/unstructured data

key_factors.factor: Depth of general engineering and staff-level seniority
Missing RAG/vector DB/agent-framework and Python skills
